alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from the learned byte embedding/readout or ordinary recency rather than input-dependent retention; the fixed-selection and recurrence-disabled roles test those alternatives.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus hash or byte-length mismatch.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives paths, roles, offsets, future bytes or another test slot's state.
Invalidate if test updates change shared slow state or tuning occurs after scoring output.
Invalidate if a mandatory PPM, CTW, LZ or dense autoregressive control is absent.

Invalidate unless all three state-space roles resolve to one implementation and share embedding, state width, diagonal dynamics, readout, initialization, fit order, context, input, update, output, constants and accounting, differing only in input-dependent versus fixed selection or recurrence-disabled intervention.

Invalidate unless pre-seed semantic fixtures prove a history-dependent selective state, fixed-selection behavior, recurrence-disabled memorylessness, predict-before-reveal ordering, byte-relabeling equivariance and explicit fit/query/update/state cost.

confounds: The visible local corpus is small, the one-epoch optimizer may underfit, dense autoregressive can exceed the state cap, and operation counts approximate backward/optimizer arithmetic rather than hardware latency.
falsification_criteria: Discard if main misses a 0.1671047931063159 improvement in mean, cold or worst-file bpb over either causal ablation or the strongest complete implementable control in any K/D cell, including D64.
Discard on nonfinite probabilities, state above 4194304 bytes, fixed-D query work varying with K, source-identity failure or Pareto dominance by a simpler complete implementable control.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify this exact width-16 shared-row-initialized chunk-64 one-epoch Adam selective-retention rule without tuning width, decay, optimizer, epoch, chunk or clipping.
outcome_policy.null: Close the exact rule if input selectivity gives no meaningful every-cell causal gain or classical controls retain the full-cost frontier.
outcome_policy.positive: Retain only the exact frozen rule for unchanged three-seed replication; do not mark promising or promote.

predicted_outcome: Expected negative: input-selective retention may beat its source-identical ablations at some long contexts but is likely to miss the frozen 0.1671047931063159 bpb every-cell conjunction or lose full cost to PPM-D/CTW.
promotion_criteria: One seed cannot promote; only the full conjunction may authorize one unchanged three-seed replication in a later wake.
